ilan.title: Cancer and Libra Couple Wall Art, Cancer Gifts, Libra Gifts, Newlywed Gift, 1st Anniversary Gift, Engagement Keepsake
ilan.description:
Personalized Cancer and Libra couple wall art with your two names and your own short message, a meaningful newlywed gift or 1st anniversary gift. Our original design joins your two zodiac symbols into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file or a print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays. A thoughtful choice when you are looking for Cancer gifts or Libra gifts.

Every fusion symbol begins as an original AstroLoveArt design. We use AI tools to help create the artwork, and every design is reviewed and finished by us.

Cancer: June 21 to July 22. Libra: September 23 to October 22.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Format: choose Digital File or Print.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors.
3. Size: choose your size. Your digital file is made in the color and size you choose.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Names must use English letters. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- One print ready JPG file in the color and size you choose
- High resolution: 300 dpi at the full size you choose, from 8 x 10 to 24 x 36 inches, or A4 to A2
- Delivered to your Etsy order within 24 hours. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Download it from Purchases in a web browser. The Etsy app can't download files
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Printed on premium matte art paper with long-lasting inks
Frames shown in photos are for display only and are not included. Prints ship unframed.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
13 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 24 x 36 inches, plus A4 to A2. Every size is available as a print and as a digital file. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 7 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders ship with tracking.

PACKAGING
Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.
How large can I print the digital file? At the size you choose, at 300 dpi. The largest size is 24 x 36 inches.

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Cancer and Libra couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.
